blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation applied to Capabilities. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

In Technology & SaaS, agentic ai & hyperautomation turns knowledge work into orchestrated autonomy. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: agentic process automation, digital workforce & multi-agent orchestration, decision intelligence systems — delivered on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Support and success scale linearly
Customer support and CS operations grow headcount with ARR; ticket deflection without resolution raises churn risk.
Velocity vs. reliability tension
Deploy frequency rises while incident load eats roadmap; error budgets exist in slide decks, not in release policy.
AI features ship without economics
Teams bolt on LLM features with no cost telemetry, no eval harness and no guardrails; margins erode silently per customer.

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: GDPR/CCPA and Sector overlays (PCI, HIPAA B2B). Compliance duties inherited from enterprise customers. Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.

Programs run on a fixed rhythm so progress is visible from week one. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
